line.comment: * Task 1329.
* Add-Ons 2.2: The old approach did not account for those infectees or underequipped/unequipped infectees.
* This script has been improved to handle the matryoshka effect and potential player exploits regarding equipment or nesting.
* Zero Hour 1.10
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: If insured (non-OCV ships built during the virus event), the base offset (variance) is reduced by 85% on hard (70% on insane).
* Never happens on easy/normal (negative events cannot occur with insurance policy); just in case.
* Hard: Reduces offset by 85%.
* Insane: Reduces offset by 70%.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Removed obsolete RNG workaround.
* Randomize infection timing by +/- the ship quality offset.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Duration reduced by 30% on insane.
* Final safety clamp: make sure it doesn’t go below 600 seconds, regardless of difficulty.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: A broadcast takeover forces this infection to mature.
* ZH 1.10 - Infected OCV-built ships immediately trigger takeover if ordered to attack Xenon or OCV targets.
* Non-OCV ships infected by the Terraformer Virus event must mature normally.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Attacking Xenon or OCV immediately matures the infection.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Non-OCV infected ships that were built during a terraformer virus event while the Outpost was insured will now show a (!) in the name. Checked once per minute.
* If the warning is not present (player renamed ship, fleet rename, etc.), then we append the warning.
* Collect ships in the sector, including docked ships.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Collect converted ships.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Collect all ships, including ships nested inside other ships.
* Seed the array with ships directly docked at stations.
* Walk the docking tree iteratively. Newly discovered ships are also checked.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Collect OCV ship designs and any ships currently infected by the OCV virus.
* Ships already owned by the OCV do not need to be converted.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Never directly convert the current player ship.
* Mark its takeover as pending so its own virus task converts it once the player leaves.
* Add-Ons 2.2: A docked ship must escape before takeover. If it is docked, force it into space.
* Find the outermost docking parent so nested ships emerge at the correct sector position.
* The ship is now spaceborne and can complete its pending takeover.
* Only player-owned ships count toward player sacrifice, reputation loss, and notifications.
* [THIS] is converted below after all other affected ships are processed.
* Stop the ship's current command and OCV virus task before changing ownership.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Convert the ship and clean up its previous fleet.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: An infected ship cannot convert while it is the player ship.
* Keep the virus task alive and complete the takeover once the player leaves.
* If [THIS] was deferred because it was the player ship, account for it now.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Convert [THIS] and clean up its previous fleet.
* Reset the ship name. Some custom ship names can produce invalid names after takeover.
* Upon conversion, the hull is repaired to 65% if its hull is below 65%.
* Sanitize the ship. Remove ALL lasers and shields (prevents exploit where player could underequip ships), then re-equip.
* Apply standard OCV internal defenses to make the ship harder for the player to recapture.
* HPD and ISL are guaranteed. Existing AFS is preserved; otherwise, AFS has a 50% chance for capitals and 25% otherwise.
* Stop/remove non-converting ships from its fleet.
* Never interrupt the current player ship.
* Converting ships are handled separately.
* Only player-owned ships count toward player sacrifice, reputation loss, and notifications.
* Player sacrifice: reputation loss and notification.
* Add-Ons 1.4.21: Update progress when ships convert. The player must sacrifice 300 fleet power worth of infected ships to advance the plot.

line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Create a new squad from all ships converted by this takeover and any existing spaceborne OCV ships in the sector.
* Include any converted ships not already found in the sector array.
* Assign converted OCV fighters a homebase.
* Ship may have been destroyed before finalization.
* Only fighters need carrier homebases.
* Find an OCV carrier with available docking capacity.
* Don't homebase to itself.
* Must have docking space.
* Must be able to dock this fighter.
* No suitable OCV carrier is available. Fighter remains independent.
